none: PAS NLM-EEE4F7: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian from Keelby
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian (364-378), Securitas Rei Publicae issue, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust draped diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: DN VALEN[---]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath and palm. Reverse inscription: [SEC]VRIT[AS]REIPVB[LICAE]. In field: OF I. Diameter: 17.5mm, Weight: 1.96gms, die axis: 6
